description:
We're seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Data Engineering team. The team is responsible for the entire data platform: ingestion from our EHR and partner feeds, the Snowflake environment itself, orchestration and CI/CD, and the outbound integrations that deliver data to our partner and vendor systems. Our analytics engineering team builds the reporting and analytics logic on top of it, and you'll work closely with them.

The team's output reaches almost every part of the business, including billing, clinical operations, patient communications, marketing, and our partner integrations. You'll be accountable for its reliability. Our data product manager brings forward the problems our stakeholders need solved, and you'll partner with them to turn those into technical plans the team can execute.

We are hiring this role in advance of scaling up the team to help the company expand into new lines of business next year.

We pride ourselves on our strong management culture and talented engineering teams.

 

About Talkiatry:

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

 

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 900+ psychiatrists, 400+ therapists, and more than 4 million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

You will:

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers working on our foundational data processing platform

  • Drive technical strategy and execution across our Snowflake platform, dbt project, our Python services on AWS (Lambda, ECS), and our Airflow orchestration layer

  • Own the Snowflake environment: access and permissions, warehouse configuration, and cost management

  • Own the reliability of these systems: on-call readiness, incident triage, and post-mortems, with escalation to engineering leadership

  • Collaborate with product, business, and other engineering teams to create high impact solutions. Work closely with analytics engineering on schema and platform changes, and with our DevOps team on the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines the platform depends on.

  • Establish robust engineering practices and technical standards across code review, testing, documentation, and CI/CD

  • Set clear goals, prioritize effectively, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions

  • Mentor team members and foster their professional growth

  • Contribute to Talkiatry’s engineering and management culture

You have:

  • 6+ years of data engineering experience

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience

  • Strong technical background with hands-on development experience with Snowflake, dbt, Python and SQL

  • Experience administering a cloud data warehouse, not only building in one: access control, cost management, and environment and release processes

  • Comfortable running production services in a cloud environment, ideally AWS: containerized workloads and serverless functions

  • Experience owning production data systems: orchestration tooling such as Airflow, monitoring and alerting, and incident response

  • Experience applying CI/CD and automated testing to data pipelines

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Track record of delivering complex software projects on time

  • Ability to balance business needs with technical excellence

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with data in a HIPAA-compliant environment

  • Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party systems and APIs

  • Working knowledge of dimensional modeling and warehouse design tradeoffs

  • Experience consolidating fragmented scheduling onto a single orchestration platform

  • Experience with Fivetran or similar ELT tooling

  • Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure as code (our DevOps team owns most of this)

Why Talkiatry:

  • Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care

  • Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup

  • Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!

  • Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands

  • It all comes back to care: we’re a mental health company, and we put our team’s well-being first

Talkiatry participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. only after a job offer is accepted and Form I-9 is completed. For more information on E-Verify, please visit the following: EVerify Participation & IER Right to Work.

At Talkiatry, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace and candidate experience. We strive to create an environment where everyone has a sense of belonging and purpose, and where we learn from the unique experiences of those around us.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
